children: Paul Morgan as chief operating officer, effective immediately, as part of its long-term Accelerate 2030 strategy.
Morgan will report directly to President and CEO Christian Ulbrich and join JLL’s Global Executive Board.
In the newly created role, he will oversee the consolidation of the company’s enterprise-wide operational expertise into a single global operations function.
Morgan previously served as chief operating officer of JLL’s Real Estate Management Services business and CEO of Workplace Management globally
